newsitem.title: JAPAN: JP Morgan sticks with Japan tankan outlook.
newsitem.headline: JP Morgan sticks with Japan tankan outlook.

text.p: JP Morgan's chief economist in Tokyo, Jesper Koll, told Reuters on Tuesday that he had not revised a forecast of plus four for the manufacturers' diffusion index in the Bank of Japan (BOJ) "tankan" quarterly corporate survey, to be released on Wednesday.
Market rumours that Koll's bullish forecast had been revised downward fuelled speculation that the tankan would show weak corporate sentiment, buoying JGB prices in morning trade.
Widespread talk that a senior BOJ official told some Japanese bank managers on Monday that the tankan would be weak also boosted JGBs.
